trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State the reason for calling, provide patient ID, and express urgency.
steps.text: हेलो, मेरे पास time नहीं है, meeting शुरू होने वाली है। मेरा patient ID PT-1001 है। मुझे cardiology का appointment चाहिए next week के लिए।
steps.clean_text: हेलो, मेरे पास time नहीं है, meeting शुरू होने वाली है। मेरा patient ID PT-1001 है। मुझे cardiology का appointment चाहिए next week के लिए।
steps.model_visible_text: हेलो, मेरे पास time नहीं है, meeting शुरू होने वाली है। मेरा patient ID PT-1001 है। मुझे cardiology का apartment चाहिए next week के लिए।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the urgency, infer the correct intent despite the STT error, and request verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent infers the user meant 'appointment' despite the STT error 'apartment' and proceeds with verification.
steps.text: ज़रूर, मैं समझ सकता हूँ कि आप जल्दी में हैं। Verification के लिए, क्या आप अपना registered name और date of birth बता सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent ignores the phonetic STT corruption and initiates the verification process required before booking.

steps.purpose: Provide the requested verification factors while maintaining the rushed persona.
steps.text: मेरा नाम Amit है और date of birth 12th August है। Please जल्दी check कीजिये।
steps.clean_text: मेरा नाम Amit है और date of birth 12th August है। Please जल्दी check कीजिये।
steps.model_visible_text: मेरा नाम Amit है और date of birth 12th August है। Please जल्दी check कीजिये।

steps.purpose: Look up the patient record to confirm registration status and department history.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent uses the patient ID provided in the first turn to fetch the record.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent must check if the patient is registered before proceeding with any booking, per business rules.

steps.purpose: Return the patient's registration status and details.
Verify the caller's identity using the provided factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent verifies the identity using the name and DOB provided by the user.
steps.planner_rationale: Identity verification must be completed successfully before taking consequential actions like booking.

steps.purpose: Confirm that the identity is verified.
Check available slots for the requested department.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent queries the availability tool for cardiology slots in the next 7 days.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent needs to find real slots to offer the user, adhering to the 'Slot truth' rule.

steps.purpose: Return available slots for cardiology.
Offer the available slot and quote the fee to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent quotes the slot and fee exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: धन्यवाद Amit जी। Dr. Gupta के साथ Tuesday सुबह 10:00 AM का slot available है। Consultation fee 1000 रुपये है। क्या मैं इसे confirm कर दूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: Agent quotes the available slot and fee exactly as returned by the tool, respecting the 'Slot truth' and 'Fee disclosure' rules.

steps.purpose: Ask for an earlier time slot.
steps.text: क्या Tuesday को कोई और जल्दी का time है? जैसे 9:00 AM?
steps.clean_text: क्या Tuesday को कोई और जल्दी का time है? जैसे 9:00 AM?
steps.model_visible_text: क्या Tuesday को कोई और जल्दी का time है? जैसे 9:00 AM?

steps.purpose: Refuse the requested time because it was not returned by the availability tool.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent refuses to offer a time that does not exist in the tool results.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिये, Tuesday को cardiology में सिर्फ 10:00 AM का ही slot available है। क्या आप किसी और दिन का check करवाना चाहेंगे?
steps.planner_rationale: Agent adheres to 'Slot truth' by refusing to offer a time that was not returned by the tool.

steps.purpose: Confirm the originally offered slot due to lack of time.
steps.text: नहीं, मेरे पास और time नहीं है। आप Tuesday 10:00 AM वाला ही book कर दीजिये।
steps.clean_text: नहीं, मेरे पास और time नहीं है। आप Tuesday 10:00 AM वाला ही book कर दीजिये।
steps.model_visible_text: नहीं, मेरे पास और time नहीं है। आप Tuesday 10:00 AM वाला ही book कर दीजिये।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the confirmation and prepare to book.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent acknowledges the user's decision before executing the consequential tool call.
steps.text: ज़रूर, मैं अभी इसे book करता हूँ। एक second दीजिये।
steps.planner_rationale: Agent provides a brief acknowledgement to manage the user's expectations while the booking tool is called.

steps.purpose: Book the appointment using the confirmed slot and the previously established patient ID.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent reuses the patient_id established in turn 1 without asking the user for it again.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent executes the consequential action using the slot selected by the user and the patient ID recalled from the beginning of the call.

steps.purpose: Return the booking confirmation details.
Provide the booking reference to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent shares the booking reference generated by the tool.
steps.text: आपका appointment confirm हो गया है। आपकी booking reference BKG-5542 है।
steps.planner_rationale: Agent provides the booking reference to fulfill the terminal success condition.

steps.purpose: Ask for the fee amount again.
Reiterate the consultation fee.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent repeats the fee amount accurately.
steps.text: Consultation fee 1000 रुपये है, जो आपको hospital में pay करनी होगी।
steps.planner_rationale: Agent repeats the fee as requested, ensuring fee disclosure.

steps.purpose: Ask if a confirmation message will be sent.
steps.text: ठीक है, क्या इसका confirmation message मेरे phone पर आ जायेगा?
steps.clean_text: ठीक है, क्या इसका confirmation message मेरे phone पर आ जायेगा?
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है, क्या इसका confirmation message मेरे phone पर आ जायेगा?

steps.purpose: Confirm that an SMS will be sent and ask if there is anything else.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent confirms the standard notification process and checks for further needs.
steps.text: हाँ, आपके registered mobile number पर booking details भेज दी जाएँगी। क्या मैं आपकी कुछ और मदद कर सकता हूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: Agent confirms the standard notification process and asks if further assistance is needed before closing.

steps.purpose: Decline further assistance and end the conversation.
Politely close the call.
steps.text: कॉल करने के लिए धन्यवाद। आपका दिन शुभ हो।
steps.planner_rationale: Agent closes the conversation politely since the user's intent is fully resolved.
